simple.meaning: דָּהַם (dâham) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to be dumb , i.e. (figuratively) dumbfounded.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Jeremiah, beginning at Jeremiah 14:9. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to דָּהַם (H1724) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: דָּהַם (dâham) / H1724 is traced through Jeremiah 14:9 with source-language evidence and verse context.
